== {{int:filedesc}} == {{Information |Description = {{en|'''Wake Vortex Study at [[:en:Wallops Flight Facility|Wallops Island]]'''
The [[:en:aerodynamics|air flow]] from the [[:en:airfoil|wing]] of this [[:en:crop duster|agricultural plane]] is made visible by a technique that uses colored smoke rising from the ground. The swirl at the wingtip traces the aircraft's [[:en:wake turbulence|wake vortex]], which exerts a powerful influence on the flow field behind the plane. Because of wake vortex, the [[:en:Federal Aviation Administration|Federal Aviation Administration]] (FAA) requires aircraft to maintain set distances behind each other when they land. A joint [[:en:NASA|NASA]]-FAA program aimed at boosting [[:en:airport|airport]] capacity, however, is aimed at determining conditions under which [[:en:airplane|planes]] may fly closer together. NASA researchers are studying wake vortex with a variety of tools, from [[:en:supercomputer|supercomputers]], to [[:en:wind tunnel|wind tunnels]], to actual flight tests in research aircraft. Their goal is to fully understand the phenomenon, then use that knowledge to create an automated system that could predict changing wake vortex conditions at airports. [[:en:Aviator|Pilots]] already know, for example, that they have to worry less about wake vortex in rough weather because windy conditions cause them to dissipate more rapidly.}} |Source = {{NASA-image|id=EL-1996-00130|center=LARC|alternateid=L90-5919}} |Date = 1990-05-04 |Author = [http://lisar.larc.nasa.gov/ NASA Langley Research Center (NASA-LaRC)], Edited by [[User:Fir0002|Fir0002]] |Permission = Public domain ([[#Licensing information|see below]]) |other_versions = File:Airplane vortex.jpg|Original version File:Airplane vortex denoicefied.jpg|Digitally altered version }} ==Recognition== {{Assessments|enwiki=1|wallpaper=1|enwiki-nom=Wingtip vortex|fawiki=1|fawiki-nom=جریان هوا در کنار هواپیما|trwiki=1|hewiki=1|hewiki-nom=ארכיון 24 #מערבולת}} == {{int:license-header}} == {{PD-USGov-NASA}} [[Category:Wingtip vortices]] [[Category:Aircraft at Langley Air Force Base]] [[Category:Cyan and red]] [[Category:Ayres Thrush]] [[Category:Flow visualization]] [[Category:Red smoke]] [[Category:Logarithmic spirals]]
